Messages.Author: Patrick Harris
Messages.Body:
> The MR card say:
> "Each weapon possessed by a minion you control inflicts +1 damage during
> combat"
> Does it mean i must choose a minion when i play the card or does it affects

It means all the weapons possessed by all the minions you control.
